content: This information is intended to provide a general overview and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This content is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and how it relates to your individual health requirements. The information was last updated in August 2024. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
